sections.text: Introduction

This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I1, 
which must be performed every 3000 hours of operation of the I&C on the F.D fan 
operation

This procedure was applied in ABU QIR power plant 
since 1985 and the final draft is issued in May2005

The first draft 
is initiated and tested by eng. Mohamed Ahmed Abd El Salam, approved by eng. 
Khalil Aly Khalil general director of Abu Kir PS, accepted by eng. Aly Anwar 
El-Fayoumy Head 
Sector of Abu Qir PS, certified 
by eng. Mona Ahmad El Sharkawy; WDEPC Inspection and Quality Control head 
sector.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety healthy, safety shoes

(J, N, S, C, K)

measure the mv according to the measurement

sections.text: Servo motor positioner

Keep all connection tightened and 
check s the connection using soapsuds.

Dismantle the rod for control valve 
and internal lines and clean it.

Dismantle the filter and clean it 
from dust.

Dismantle the nut fixing for the 
valve and put out the valve body and lub. it.

Put light oil on the valve in the 
spring axis.
Check the adjustment.

sections.text: Positioner calibration
Connect the air source with 20 PSI.
Inject the signal from 3 to 15 PSI.

Calibrate the zero by inject 3 PSI 
and adjust the zero from screw zero adjustment.

Calibrate the max by inject the 15 
PSI and adjust the max from screw large adjustment.
Make sure for middle scale.

sections.text: Converter calibration

Make sure of electrical terminals 
tighten and check the supply air pressure.

Check the terminal and connection 
(insulation).

Check the converter by send the 
control electrical current to converter and measure the pneumatic o/p signal.

Insject 4-20 MA and adjust the out 
put form 3-15 PS.
